settings.label: Brand name
settings.info: Shown as the wordmark in the header and footer. Leave blank to use the Shopify store name from Settings → Store details.

settings.label: Social sharing image
settings.info: Used when someone shares your homepage on social media. 1200 × 630 px works best.

settings.label: Heading font
settings.info: Try Prata, Marcellus, Italiana, Cormorant Garamond or Playfair Display for a jewellery feel.

settings.label: Body font
settings.info: Try Jost, Karla, Work Sans, DM Sans or Tenor Sans.

settings.label: Text
settings.default: Join the list for first access to new pieces, restocks and the occasional quiet sale.

settings.label: Discount code to reveal
settings.info: Create this code first under Discounts, then enter it here. Subscribers see it after signing up.

settings.label: Success message
settings.default: You're in. Use this code at checkout:

settings.label: Popup image
settings.info: Optional. A single product shot works well.

settings.label: Free shipping threshold
settings.info: Order subtotal (whole units of your store currency) that unlocks the free-shipping message in the cart. This is display only — it must match the rates you set under Settings → Shipping and delivery.
